description.en: Fixed autosave: forces a save every 60 minutes no matter what, but after 45 minutes without a save it starts watching for a ~60s AFK gap and sneaks a save in then instead of interrupting you.

text.name: ss_enabled_info
text.en: Turn off if you're testing a mod that might trash the world and don't want it autosaved.

text.name: ss_saveIntervalMinutes_info
text.en: Hard ceiling: always saves after this long, no matter what. Also starts watching for a short AFK gap to sneak an earlier save into once 75% of this has passed.
